title: 16-06-pace-code-c-2015.pdf — section 3
text:
1.7 ‘The appropriate adult’ means, in the case of a:
 3
(a) juvenile:
(i) the parent, relative, guardian or, if the juvenile is
in care, a member of a care authority, or voluntary
organisation;
(ii) a social worker;
(iii) failing these, some other responsible adult aged 18
or over who is not a police officer or employed by
the Northern Ireland Policing Board.
(b) person who is mentally disordered or mentally vulnerable: See
Note 1D.
(i) a parent, relative, guardian or other person
responsible for their care or custody;
(ii) someone experienced in dealing with mentally
disordered or mentally vulnerable people but who is
not a police officer or employed by the Northern
Ireland Policing Board;
(iii) failing these, some other responsible adult aged 18
or over who is not a police officer or employed by
the Northern Ireland Policing Board.
1.7A A ‘Registered Intermediary’ is a person with specialist
communication skills who has been accredited by the Department
of Justice as a Registered Intermediary to provide assistance to a
detained person who has significant communication difficulties.
See Note 1GG.
